package com.synexia.mindex.swap;

import java.nio.BufferOverflowException;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.util.Optional;

/** JNI bulk page transforms backed by the existing synexia_mindex_swap library. */
final class JniSwapPageBinaryOps implements SwapPageBinaryOps {
  private static final int ABI_VERSION = 2;

  private JniSwapPageBinaryOps() {}

  static Optional<SwapPageBinaryOps> tryCreate() {
    try {
      SwapNativeLibrary.load();
      return nativePageAbiVersion() == ABI_VERSION
          ? Optional.of(new JniSwapPageBinaryOps())
          : Optional.empty();
    } catch (LinkageError failure) {
      return Optional.empty();
    }
  }

  @Override
  public String id() {
    return "jni";
  }

  @Override
  public boolean nativeBackend() {
    return true;
  }

  @Override
  public int copy(ByteBuffer source, ByteBuffer target) {
    if (source == null || target == null) {
      throw new NullPointerException(source == null ? "source" : "target");
    }
    JavaSwapPageBinaryOps.writable(target, "target");
    if (!source.isDirect() || !target.isDirect()) {
      return JavaSwapPageBinaryOps.INSTANCE.copy(source, target);
    }
    if (target.remaining() < source.remaining()) throw new BufferOverflowException();

    int result =
        nativeCopy(
            source,
            source.position(),
            source.remaining(),
            target,
            target.position(),
            target.remaining());
    return requireStatus(result, "copy");
  }

  @Override
  public int deltaEncodeMonotonicLongs(ByteBuffer sourceLongs, ByteBuffer target) {
    if (sourceLongs == null || target == null) {
      throw new NullPointerException(sourceLongs == null ? "sourceLongs" : "target");
    }
    JavaSwapPageBinaryOps.writable(target, "target");
    if ((sourceLongs.remaining() & (Long.BYTES - 1)) != 0) {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("long lane byte length must be a multiple of 8");
    }
    if (!sourceLongs.isDirect() || !target.isDirect()) {
      return JavaSwapPageBinaryOps.INSTANCE.deltaEncodeMonotonicLongs(sourceLongs, target);
    }

    int result =
        nativeDeltaEncode(
            sourceLongs,
            sourceLongs.position(),
            sourceLongs.remaining(),
            target,
            target.position(),
            target.remaining());
    return requireStatus(result, "delta encode");
  }

  @Override
  public int deltaDecodeMonotonicLongs(ByteBuffer encoded, ByteBuffer targetLongs) {
    if (encoded == null || targetLongs == null) {
      throw new NullPointerException(encoded == null ? "encoded" : "targetLongs");
    }
    JavaSwapPageBinaryOps.writable(targetLongs, "targetLongs");
    if (!encoded.isDirect() || !targetLongs.isDirect()) {
      return JavaSwapPageBinaryOps.INSTANCE.deltaDecodeMonotonicLongs(encoded, targetLongs);
    }

    int result =
        nativeDeltaDecode(
            encoded,
            encoded.position(),
            encoded.remaining(),
            targetLongs,
            targetLongs.position(),
            targetLongs.remaining());
    return requireStatus(result, "delta decode");
  }

  private static int requireStatus(int status, String operation) {
    if (status >= 0) return status;
    switch (status) {
      case -2 -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(operation + " rejected malformed page data");
      case -3 -> throw new BufferOverflowException();
      case -4 -> throw new java.nio.ReadOnlyBufferException();
      case -5 -> throw new OutOfMemoryError(operation + " overlap scratch allocation failed");
      default -> throw new IllegalStateException(operation + " rejected validated direct buffers");
    }
  }

  private static native int nativePageAbiVersion();

  private static native int nativeCopy(
      ByteBuffer source,
      int sourcePosition,
      int sourceLength,
      ByteBuffer target,
      int targetPosition,
      int targetRemaining);

  private static native int nativeDeltaEncode(
      ByteBuffer sourceLongs,
      int sourcePosition,
      int sourceLength,
      ByteBuffer target,
      int targetPosition,
      int targetRemaining);

  private static native int nativeDeltaDecode(
      ByteBuffer encoded,
      int sourcePosition,
      int sourceLength,
      ByteBuffer targetLongs,
      int targetPosition,
      int targetRemaining);
}
